pre_record.code:
from shg_addon.z_control import guard
guard(globals())

from shg_addon.actions import execute
execute(globals(), 'acquire_point', **{})

pre.hook:
from shg_addon.actions import execute
execute(globals(), 'prepare_scan', **{})

mems_drive = float(get('MEMS.Vd'))
if not np.isfinite(mems_drive) or mems_drive <= 0:
    raise ValueError('Set MEMS.Vd explicitly to a finite positive drive voltage before running this sweep; the preset preserves drive voltage and output-enable states')

from shg_addon.z_control import prepare
prepare(globals())

metadata.comment: SHG: half-wave x MEMS x Vz. Vlock is set to 70 V and verified before any Vz write; guards precede each z step and each spectrum. Vlock remains at 70 V on finish/abort. Review ranges, drive voltage and output-enable states before starting.
